title: Sort Inbound Emails with Zoho Flow and AI #Shorts
description:
Stop triaging customer emails by hand. Connect Zoho Mail and OpenAI inside Zoho Flow to automatically classify intent and route each message to Zoho CRM or Zoho Desk.

1. Create a Flow with 'Email' as the trigger.
2. Add an 'AI' step (OpenAI or Claude) to classify the email body as 'Lead', 'Support', or 'Billing'.
3. Add a Decision box: If 'Lead', create a CRM Lead; if 'Support', create a Desk Ticket.

API / tool used:
- name: Zoho Flow OpenAI Connector
- endpoint: OpenAI App / Create chat completion action
- scope: Flow Integration
- docs: Zoho Flow AI Integrations

AI + Zoho automations every day - follow @GSXAutomation
